title: Flow Visualization Feature Epic
description:
Implement comprehensive project flow visualization to show task dependencies and help users understand project structure at a glance.

Goals:
- Visualize dependency chains (left=ready, right=goals)
- Support multiple output formats (text, SVG, JSON, DOT)
- Enable critical path analysis with --goal flag
- Provide both quick overview and detailed exploration modes
- Integrate cleanly with existing pebbles commands

Success: Users can see their project flow, identify ready tasks, understand dependencies, and find critical paths to goals without external tools.
